files_note: LOGCUBE and LOGRSS are Git-ignored (>100 MB each) and fetched/verified by download.sh; the published MAPS is committed.
name: NGC 1194
notes: Real MaNGA DR17 LOGCUBE and LOGRSS, downloaded unmodified from the public SDSS SAS. The LOGCUBE is the DAP datacube; LOGRSS is loaded by the official MaNGADataCube to compute the spatial covariance matrix used by the Voronoi binning, not fit as a spectrum. The published DAP MAPS is the independent all-spaxel reference; it is stored unmodified and is never described as the output of this repository's DAP run. The full all-spaxel 2397-bin DAP emission-line stage exceeded the 58 min wall-clock budget; the accepted product is the official full-method SASUKE fit on 9 central single-spaxel bins, with the published MAPS as the all-spaxel reference.

products.manga_target3_note: MNGTARG3=6 means the object was observed through an ancillary target selection (the exact ancillary bit label is survey metadata, not a DAP input). NGC 1194 is independently a catalogued Seyfert 2 and is included in the MaNGA AGN Catalog VAC used here.

redshift_note: NSA v1_0_1 z=0.0136253 from DRPall v3_1_1 (rounded key uses 0.0136). SIMBAD gives cz=0.0135689; the DAP uses the NSA systemic redshift so velocities are relative to the same zero point as the published MAPS.
